topics.title: Result complements: 看见 kànjiàn, 听懂 tīngdǒng
topics.summary: A second word after the verb says how the action ended.
topics.pattern: Verb + Result (完 wán, 好 hǎo, 懂 dǒng, 见 jiàn, 到 dào, 错 cuò …)
text: Chinese often splits "doing" from "succeeding". kàn is to look; kànjiàn is to look and actually see. tīng is to listen; tīngdǒng is to listen and understand.

Common results: wán finished (chīwán, eaten up), hǎo done properly (zuòhǎo), dǒng understood, jiàn perceived, dào reached or managed (zhǎodào, found), cuò wrongly (xiěcuò, wrote it wrong), gānjìng clean (xǐ gānjìng).
The negative is méi: wǒ méi tīngdǒng, I didn't understand. le goes after the result: wǒ chīwánle.

examples.t: 我/wǒ 看见/kànjiàn 他/tā 了/le 。
你/nǐ 听懂/tīngdǒng 了/le 吗/ma ？
我/wǒ 吃完/chīwán 了/le 。
我/wǒ 找到/zhǎodào 我/wǒ 的/de 钥匙/yàoshi 了/le 。
对不起/duìbuqǐ ， 我/wǒ 写错/xiěcuò 了/le 。

mistakes.wrong: 我/wǒ 没/méi 听懂/tīngdǒng 了/le 。

exercises.t: 我/wǒ 已经/yǐjīng 做完/zuòwán 作业/zuòyè 了/le 。
你/nǐ 看见/kànjiàn 我/wǒ 的/de 手机/shǒujī 了/le 吗/ma ？
老师/lǎoshī 说/shuō 的/de 话/huà 我/wǒ 都/dōu 听/tīng _ 了/le 。
exercises.en: I understood everything the teacher said.
exercises.why: Listening that ends in understanding: tīngdǒng.

exercises.t: 我/wǒ 找/zhǎo _ 工作/gōngzuò 了/le ！

options: 我/wǒ 不/bù 看见/kànjiàn 了/le 。
你/nǐ 看完/kànwán 那/nà 本/běn 书/shū 了/le 吗/ma ？
你/nǐ 看/kàn 那/nà 本/běn 书/shū 完/wán 了/le 吗/ma ？
exercises.why: The result sticks to the verb: kànwán.

topics.title: Direction: 来 lái, 去 qù, 上来 shànglai
topics.summary: lái means towards the speaker, qù away; they follow the verb.
topics.pattern: Verb + (上 shàng / 下 xià / 进 jìn / 出 chū / 回 huí / 过 guò / 起 qǐ) + 来 lai / 去 qu
text: After a verb of movement, lai means towards me (the speaker) and qu means away: jìnlai! come in! (to where I am); tā chūqu le, he went out.
A direction can come in between: zǒu shànglai, walk up (towards me); ná chūqu, take it out (away); pǎo huílai, run back here.
A place goes before lái/qù: tā huí jiā qù le, he went home. Huí Zhōngguó lái, come back to China.

examples.t: 请/qǐng 进来/jìnlai 。
他/tā 出去/chūqu 了/le 。
你/nǐ 什么/shénme 时候/shíhou 回来/huílai ？
她/tā 从/cóng 楼上/lóushàng 走/zǒu 下来/xiàlai 了/le 。
把/bǎ 书/shū 拿/ná 出来/chūlai 。

mistakes.wrong: 他/tā 回去/huíqu 家/jiā 了/le 。
mistakes.right: 他/tā 回/huí 家/jiā 去/qu 了/le 。

exercises.t: 你/nǐ 快/kuài 下来/xiàlai 吧/ba 。
他/tā 跑/pǎo 回来/huílai 了/le 。
（ 你/nǐ 在/zài 房间/fángjiān 里/li ） 请/qǐng 进/jìn _ ！
exercises.en: (You're in the room) Please come in!

exercises.t: （ 在/zài 家/jiā ） 妈妈/māma 说/shuō ： 快/kuài 回/huí _ ！
exercises.en: (At home) Mum says: come back quickly!
exercises.why: Towards the speaker (mum, at home): huílai.

options: 她/tā 回/huí 北京/Běijīng 去/qu 了/le 。
她/tā 回去/huíqu 北京/Běijīng 了/le 。

topics.title: Can or can't manage it: 听得懂 tīng de dǒng
topics.summary: Put de or bu between a verb and its result: able or unable to.
topics.pattern: Verb + 得 de / 不 bu + Result
text: Insert de into a result complement and it means "can manage to": tīng de dǒng, can understand (by listening). Insert bu and it means "can't manage to": tīng bu dǒng, can't understand.
These are how Chinese usually says can/can't for results: kàn bu jiàn, can't see; chī bu wán, can't finish (eating); mǎi bu dào, can't get hold of; huí bu lái, can't come back.
Ask with the two together: nǐ tīng de dǒng tīng bu dǒng? or just nǐ tīng de dǒng ma?

examples.t: 我/wǒ 听/tīng 得/de 懂/dǒng 。
他/tā 说/shuō 得/de 太/tài 快/kuài ， 我/wǒ 听/tīng 不/bu 懂/dǒng 。
examples.en: He speaks too fast, I can't understand.

examples.t: 太/tài 多/duō 了/le ， 我/wǒ 吃/chī 不/bu 完/wán 。
examples.en: It's too much, I can't finish it.

examples.t: 后面/hòumian 的/de 人/rén 看/kàn 得/de 见/jiàn 吗/ma ？
examples.en: Can the people at the back see?

examples.t: 今天/jīntiān 我/wǒ 回/huí 不/bu 来/lái 了/le 。

exercises.t: 这/zhè 个/ge 字/zì 你/nǐ 看/kàn 得/de 懂/dǒng 吗/ma ？
我/wǒ 一个人/yīgèrén 吃/chī 不/bu 完/wán 。
exercises.en: I can't finish it on my own.

exercises.t: 字/zì 太/tài 小/xiǎo 了/le ， 我/wǒ 看/kàn _ 清楚/qīngchu 。
exercises.en: The characters are too small, I can't see them clearly.

exercises.t: 你/nǐ 说/shuō 慢/màn 一点儿/yīdiǎnr 我/wǒ 就/jiù 听/tīng _ 懂/dǒng 。
exercises.en: If you speak a bit slower I can understand.

options: 我/wǒ 找/zhǎo 不/bu 到/dào 。
我/wǒ 不/bù 找/zhǎo 到/dào 。
exercises.why: bu goes between the verb and the result.

options: 你/nǐ 听/tīng 得/de 见/jiàn 吗/ma ？
你/nǐ 听见/tīngjiàn 得/de 吗/ma ？
exercises.why: de goes between verb and result: tīng de jiàn.

topics.title: 把 bǎ: doing something to something
topics.summary: bǎ moves the object before the verb to say what happens to it.
topics.pattern: Subject + 把 bǎ + Object + Verb + Result/Place
text: With bǎ the object moves in front of the verb, and the sentence is about what happens to it: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shang, I put the book on the table.
The verb can't stand alone: something must follow it, such as a result, a place, a direction or le. Bǎ mén guān shang, close the door. Bǎ zhè ge chī le, eat this.

The object is something specific (this book, the door). Use bǎ for instructions and for putting, giving, moving and changing things; a negative goes before bǎ: bié bǎ shǒujī wàng le, don't forget your phone.

examples.t: 我/wǒ 把/bǎ 书/shū 放/fàng 在/zài 桌子/zhuōzi 上/shang 了/le 。
examples.en: I put the book on the table.

examples.t: 请/qǐng 把/bǎ 门/mén 关上/guānshang 。
他/tā 把/bǎ 我/wǒ 的/de 蛋糕/dàngāo 吃/chī 了/le ！
你/nǐ 把/bǎ 作业/zuòyè 做完/zuòwán 了/le 吗/ma ？
别/bié 把/bǎ 手机/shǒujī 忘/wàng 了/le 。

mistakes.wrong: 我/wǒ 把/bǎ 书/shū 看/kàn 。
mistakes.right: 我/wǒ 把/bǎ 书/shū 看完/kànwán 了/le 。
mistakes.why: After bǎ the verb needs something after it (a result, le …).

mistakes.wrong: 我/wǒ 把/bǎ 门/mén 没/méi 关/guān 。
mistakes.right: 我/wǒ 没/méi 把/bǎ 门/mén 关上/guānshang 。

exercises.t: 请/qǐng 把/bǎ 窗户/chuānghu 打开/dǎkāi 。
我/wǒ 把/bǎ 钱/qián 给/gěi 他/tā 了/le 。

exercises.en: I put the keys in the bag.
options: 我/wǒ 把/bǎ 钥匙/yàoshi 放/fàng 在/zài 包/bāo 里/li 了/le 。
我/wǒ 把/bǎ 钥匙/yàoshi 放/fàng 。
我/wǒ 放/fàng 把/bǎ 钥匙/yàoshi 在/zài 包/bāo 里/li 。
exercises.why: bǎ + object + verb + where it went.

options: 我/wǒ 把/bǎ 书/shū 没/méi 带来/dàilai 。
我/wǒ 没/méi 把/bǎ 书/shū 带来/dàilai 。

exercises.t: 你/nǐ _ 这/zhè 杯/bēi 水/shuǐ 喝/hē 了/le 吧/ba 。
exercises.why: Doing something to a specific object: bǎ.

exercises.t: 请/qǐng 把/bǎ 衣服/yīfu 洗/xǐ _ 。
exercises.why: After bǎ the verb needs a result: xǐ gānjìng.

topics.title: 被 bèi: something was done to it
topics.summary: The passive: what something had done to it, often unwelcome.
topics.pattern: Thing + 被 bèi (+ Doer) + Verb + Result/了 le
text: bèi turns the sentence round: wǒ de zìxíngchē bèi tōu le, my bike was stolen. The doer can follow bèi: bèi xiǎotōu tōu le, stolen by a thief.
It's mostly used for things that went badly: being stolen, broken, criticised, caught in the rain. For neutral things Chinese usually just drops the doer: fàn zuò hǎo le, the food is ready (no bèi).
As with bǎ, the verb needs something after it (le, a result), and méi goes before bèi.

examples.t: 我/wǒ 的/de 自行车/zìxíngchē 被/bèi 偷/tōu 了/le 。
他/tā 被/bèi 老师/lǎoshī 批评/pīpíng 了/le 。
examples.en: He was told off by the teacher.

examples.t: 蛋糕/dàngāo 被/bèi 弟弟/dìdi 吃完/chīwán 了/le 。
examples.en: The cake was eaten up by my little brother.

examples.t: 我/wǒ 的/de 手机/shǒujī 没/méi 被/bèi 拿走/názǒu 。
杯子/bēizi 被/bèi 打破/dǎpò 了/le 。

mistakes.wrong: 我/wǒ 的/de 钱包/qiánbāo 被/bèi 偷/tōu 。
mistakes.right: 我/wǒ 的/de 钱包/qiánbāo 被/bèi 偷/tōu 了/le 。
mistakes.why: The verb after bèi needs le or a result.

exercises.t: 我/wǒ 的/de 电脑/diànnǎo 被/bèi 弟弟/dìdi 弄坏/nònghuài 了/le 。
exercises.en: My computer was broken by my little brother.

exercises.t: 他/tā 被/bèi 雨/yǔ 淋/lín 湿/shī 了/le 。
exercises.en: He got soaked by the rain.

exercises.t: 我/wǒ 的/de 钱包/qiánbāo _ 偷/tōu 了/le 。
exercises.why: Something was done to it: bèi.

exercises.en: The window was broken by the kids.
options: 窗户/chuānghu 被/bèi 孩子们/háizimen 打破/dǎpò 了/le 。
孩子们/háizimen 被/bèi 窗户/chuānghu 打破/dǎpò 了/le 。
我/wǒ 的/de 自行车/zìxíngchē 没/méi 被/bèi 偷/tōu 。
我/wǒ 的/de 自行车/zìxíngchē 被/bèi 没/méi 偷/tōu 。

exercises.t: 他/tā 把/bǎ 我/wǒ 的/de 咖啡/kāfēi 喝/hē 了/le 。 = 我/wǒ 的/de 咖啡/kāfēi _ 他/tā 喝/hē 了/le 。
exercises.en: He drank my coffee. = My coffee was drunk by him.
exercises.why: bǎ (he did it to the coffee) turned round is bèi (the coffee had it done to it).

topics.title: 是…的 shì … de: when, where, how it happened
topics.summary: For past events: stress the when, where, how or who.
topics.pattern: Subject + 是 shì + Detail + Verb + 的 de
text: When you already know something happened and want to talk about a detail, wrap the detail in shì … de: wǒ shì zuótiān lái de, I came yesterday (it was yesterday that I came).
It's how you ask the classic questions: nǐ shì shénme shíhou lái de? when did you come? nǐ shì zěnme lái de? how did you get here? Wǒ shì zuò fēijī lái de, I came by plane.
shì is often dropped in speech, but de stays. The negative is bú shì … de: wǒ bú shì zuò huǒchē lái de.

examples.t: 我/wǒ 是/shì 昨天/zuótiān 到/dào 的/de 。
你/nǐ 是/shì 怎么/zěnme 来/lái 的/de ？
我/wǒ 是/shì 坐/zuò 飞机/fēijī 来/lái 的/de 。
你们/nǐmen 是/shì 在/zài 哪儿/nǎr 认识/rènshi 的/de ？
这/zhè 不/bú 是/shì 我/wǒ 做/zuò 的/de 。
examples.en: I wasn't the one who did this.

mistakes.wrong: 我/wǒ 是/shì 昨天/zuótiān 来/lái 了/le 。
mistakes.right: 我/wǒ 是/shì 昨天/zuótiān 来/lái 的/de 。

exercises.t: 我/wǒ 是/shì 二〇二四年/èrlíngèrsìnián 开始/kāishǐ 学/xué 中文/Zhōngwén 的/de 。

你/nǐ 是/shì 什么/shénme 时候/shíhou 回来/huílai _ ？
exercises.why: Asking when it happened: shì … de.

options: 我们/wǒmen 是/shì 在/zài 北京/Běijīng 认识/rènshi 的/de 。
我们/wǒmen 认识/rènshi 是/shì 在/zài 北京/Běijīng 的/de 。
我/wǒ 没/méi 是/shì 坐/zuò 火车/huǒchē 来/lái 的/de 。
我/wǒ 不/bú 是/shì 坐/zuò 火车/huǒchē 来/lái 的/de 。

exercises.t: 这/zhè 件/jiàn 衣服/yīfu 是/shì 在/zài 哪儿/nǎr 买/mǎi _ ？
exercises.en: Where did you buy this piece of clothing?
exercises.why: Asking where it happened: shì … de.

topics.title: 就 jiù and 才 cái: sooner or later than expected
topics.summary: jiù: already, as early as. cái: only then, not until.
topics.pattern: Time + 就 jiù + Verb + 了 le · Time + 才 cái + Verb
text: jiù and cái go before the verb and say how a time feels: tā liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le, he was up as early as six. Tā shí diǎn cái qǐchuáng, he didn't get up until ten.
jiù usually comes with le; cái never does.
jiù also means "then, right away": wǒ chīle fàn jiù zǒu, I'll leave right after eating. And it links conditions: rúguǒ xià yǔ, wǒ jiù bú qù, if it rains, then I won't go.

examples.t: 他/tā 六/liù 点/diǎn 就/jiù 起床/qǐchuáng 了/le 。
examples.en: He was up at six already.

examples.t: 她/tā 十/shí 点/diǎn 才/cái 来/lái 。
我/wǒ 马上/mǎshàng 就/jiù 到/dào 。
你/nǐ 怎么/zěnme 现在/xiànzài 才/cái 来/lái ？
examples.en: Why are you only coming now?

examples.t: 如果/rúguǒ 下雨/xiàyǔ ， 我们/wǒmen 就/jiù 不/bù 去/qù 了/le 。
examples.en: If it rains, we won't go.

mistakes.wrong: 他/tā 十二/shí'èr 点/diǎn 才/cái 睡觉/shuìjiào 了/le 。
mistakes.right: 他/tā 十二/shí'èr 点/diǎn 才/cái 睡觉/shuìjiào 。

exercises.t: 我/wǒ 吃/chī 了/le 饭/fàn 就/jiù 走/zǒu 。
他/tā 学/xué 了/le 三/sān 年/nián 才/cái 学会/xuéhuì 。
exercises.en: It took him three years to learn it.

exercises.t: 电影/diànyǐng 七/qī 点/diǎn 开始/kāishǐ ， 他/tā 八/bā 点/diǎn _ 到/dào 。
exercises.en: The film started at seven; he didn't arrive until eight.

exercises.t: 她/tā 五/wǔ 岁/suì _ 会/huì 游泳/yóuyǒng 了/le 。
exercises.en: She could already swim at five.
exercises.why: Earlier than expected, with le: jiù.

exercises.en: I only got up at eleven.
options: 我/wǒ 十一/shíyī 点/diǎn 才/cái 起床/qǐchuáng 。
我/wǒ 十一/shíyī 点/diǎn 才/cái 起床/qǐchuáng 了/le 。
如果/rúguǒ 你/nǐ 累/lèi 了/le ， 就/jiù 休息/xiūxi 吧/ba 。
如果/rúguǒ 你/nǐ 累/lèi 了/le ， 才/cái 休息/xiūxi 吧/ba 。
exercises.why: Linking a condition and what follows: jiù.

topics.title: Because, so, although, but
topics.summary: Pairs: 因为…所以 yīnwèi … suǒyǐ, 虽然…但是 suīrán … dànshì.
topics.pattern: 因为 yīnwèi A，所以 suǒyǐ B · 虽然 suīrán A，但是 dànshì B
text: Chinese likes to mark both halves: yīnwèi xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù, because it rained, (so) I didn't go. Either word can be left out, but using both is natural, and the reason usually comes first.
Same with "although": suīrán hěn guì, dànshì hěn hǎo, although it's expensive, (but) it's good. English drops the "but"; Chinese keeps it. kěshì can replace dànshì.
Asking why: wèishénme? Answer with yīnwèi …

examples.t: 因为/yīnwèi 下雨/xiàyǔ ， 所以/suǒyǐ 我/wǒ 没/méi 去/qù 。
examples.en: Because it rained, I didn't go.

examples.t: 虽然/suīrán 中文/Zhōngwén 很/hěn 难/nán ， 但是/dànshì 很/hěn 有意思/yǒuyìsi 。
examples.en: Although Chinese is hard, it's interesting.

examples.t: 我/wǒ 学/xué 中文/Zhōngwén ， 因为/yīnwèi 我/wǒ 女朋友/nǚpéngyou 是/shì 中国人/Zhōngguórén 。

examples.t: 他/tā 虽然/suīrán 很/hěn 忙/máng ， 可是/kěshì 每天/měitiān 都/dōu 跑步/pǎobù 。
examples.en: Although he's busy, he runs every day.

examples.t: 我/wǒ 太/tài 累/lèi 了/le ， 所以/suǒyǐ 早/zǎo 睡/shuì 了/le 。

mistakes.wrong: 所以/suǒyǐ 我/wǒ 没/méi 去/qù ， 因为/yīnwèi 下雨/xiàyǔ 。
mistakes.right: 因为/yīnwèi 下雨/xiàyǔ ， 所以/suǒyǐ 我/wǒ 没/méi 去/qù 。
mistakes.why: suǒyǐ introduces the result, which comes second.

exercises.t: 因为/yīnwèi 我/wǒ 病/bìng 了/le ， 所以/suǒyǐ 没/méi 去/qù 上班/shàngbān 。
exercises.en: Because I was ill, I didn't go to work.

exercises.t: 虽然/suīrán 很/hěn 贵/guì ， 但是/dànshì 我/wǒ 很/hěn 喜欢/xǐhuan 。
exercises.en: Although it's expensive, I really like it.

exercises.t: 虽然/suīrán 下雨/xiàyǔ 了/le ， _ 我们/wǒmen 还是/háishi 去/qù 了/le 。
exercises.en: Although it rained, we still went.

exercises.t: _ 太/tài 晚/wǎn 了/le ， 所以/suǒyǐ 我/wǒ 打车/dǎchē 回家/huíjiā 。
exercises.en: Because it was too late, I took a taxi home.
